verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, cost, mechanics, and cross-taxonomy status. Preserve unresolved probability fields as null.
research_scope: Evil Whirlwind — Strike Super acquisition and defensive Ki-Blast interaction research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository exact-name coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Evil Whirlwind was found. The canonical Future Warrior identity is Super / Strike; the separate Gohan (Beast) Evasive variant is not merged into this record.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies the Future Warrior-accessible Evil Whirlwind as a Strike Super. Gohan (Beast) has a separate Evasive implementation of the technique, which is preserved as a distinct variant rather than changing the canonical Super identity.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The Xenoverse 2 Future Warrior route is Parallel Quest 36 — The Cell Games Begin, with the skill randomly awarded from the quest. Independent documentation corroborates the PQ36 route.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the reviewed evidence establishes the PQ36 reward route but does not establish that the Ultimate Finish is mandatory for Evil Whirlwind.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The Super version documents 100 Ki. Stamina cost is null for the Super record because the 300-Stamina value belongs to the separate Gohan (Beast) Evasive implementation.

records.name: Evil Whirlwind
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 36 — The Cell Games Begin
records.skill_description: A spinning kick that releases a hurricane-like strike around the user and can be performed while guarding, knocking the opponent away.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference documents a close-range spinning kick with knockback that can be activated while guarding. The skill is distinct from the Gohan (Beast) Evasive implementation, which consumes stamina; that variant is not used to populate the Super record's stamina field.
records.acquisition_notes: Evil Whirlwind can randomly drop for the Future Warrior from PQ36. The reviewed sources do not establish an Ultimate Finish requirement, so the field remains null rather than being inferred from general PQ farming advice.
records.pve_notes: PQ36 reward route; exact RNG probability unresolved.
records.pvp_notes: Guard-compatible spinning Strike attack with knockback. Detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
